description: This file defines the PersistentStateFactory class for creating instances of IPersistentState<TState> for grains, as well as the implementation of PersistentState<TState> which handles state storage lifecycle, including initialization and cleanup within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: PersistentStateFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating persistent state instances for grains.

classes.name: PersistentState
classes.description: Implementation of IPersistentState<TState> managing state storage and lifecycle.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an IPersistentState<TState> instance based on the grain context and configuration.

methods.name: GetFullStateName
methods.description: Generates the full state name, defaulting to the configuration setting.

methods.name: ThrowMissingProviderException
methods.description: Throws an exception if the storage provider is missing for the given configuration.

methods.name: PersistentState
methods.description: Constructor initializing the persistent state, subscribing to lifecycle events.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Handles the startup logic for the persistent state, loading state if necessary.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Handles the shutdown logic for the persistent state.
